description: This PHP class defines the ScheduledInterviewSummary object within the OrangeHRM dashboard module. It implements an ActionSummary interface and uses traits to incorporate employee action summary services. The class manages candidate IDs and provides methods to retrieve group information and pending interview counts.

classes.name: ScheduledInterviewSummary
classes.description: Represents a summary of scheduled interviews for candidates, providing group info and pending actions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with an array of accessible candidate IDs.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID associated with scheduled interviews, which is 5.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name 'Candidates To Interview'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of actionable scheduled interviews for the accessible candidates.
